s.note: Crisp parmesan and pea risotto balls, made for sharing.
s.how: Soften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time until creamy and tender. Stir in the parmesan and peas, spread on a tray and chill until firm. Roll into 12 balls around a cube of mozzarella, dip in egg and roll in panko. Fry at 180C until golden and hot in the middle.

s.note: Smoky black beans with lime and corn chips.
s.how: Warm the spices in the oil for a minute. Blend the beans, garlic, spiced oil and lime juice with a splash of water until smooth. Spread in a bowl, scatter with feta and serve with corn chips.

m.note: Whole snapper baked in a salt crust, lemon butter.
m.how: Mix the salt with the egg whites until it feels like wet sand. Stuff the fish with lemon slices and thyme, lay it on a bed of salt and pack the rest over it. Bake at 200C, with the potatoes boiling alongside. Melt the butter with lemon juice, crack the crust at the table and serve with the potatoes.

m.n: Amaze amaze amaze five-spice pork belly
m.note: Crackling pork belly with five-spice and greens. Amaze amaze amaze.
m.how: Rub the flesh side of the pork with the five-spice, soy and honey, keeping the skin dry, then rub salt into the skin. Roast at 160C, then turn up to 240C until the skin crackles. Cook the rice and steam the bok choy, then dress it with sesame oil. Rest the pork, chop into thick pieces and serve with the rice and greens.

w.note: Crisp meringue, cream and passionfruit, a small-to-medium whoop of a pavlova.
w.how: Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and spread into a 20cm round on a lined tray. Bake at 120C, then turn off the oven and leave it inside to cool. Whip the cream, pile it on and top with strawberries and passionfruit.

d.note: Aperol, prosecco and soda with blood orange. A line of infrared between Sun and Venus.
d.how: Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and add 60ml Aperol to each. Top with prosecco and a splash of soda and tuck in a slice of blood orange.
